items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: Sidney Gonzalez, Jr. I don't know. I don't know. I don't remember him.

ctx.x: Why did he send you that?

I have no idea unless it was in that thing, the second line that I showed you. This is Blaise D'Antoni's little child, Donna. She went into Hollywood and became a movie star. Oh, I remember that. Yeah. Donna D'Antoni. Sidney Gonzalez, Jr. I don't know. I don't know. I don't remember him. Did you please play something specially for me? For Mr. George Montagnet. Montagnet. M-O-N-T-A-G-N-E-T. Who is in our party. Thanks, Sid Gonzalez. That was at the Blue Room. We could not dedicate any numbers to anyone because if…
Well you had Kappa, you were out on that label Kappa. Yeah. Yeah, I remember you played Tin Roof. Raymond. Oh yeah, that's a good shot of Raymond. I was waiting for that.
